title: Website & Portal Head
description:
**Employment Type:** Full-time, Fixed-term Project Appointment (4 Months; Extension Not Guaranteed)  
**Vacancies:** 1

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced website and digital platform professional to lead the development, maintenance and day-to-day management of the project's website and portal. The role requires coordination between technical teams, content teams and project stakeholders to ensure reliable delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan and oversee website and portal development, configuration and maintenance.
* Translate project requirements into technical tasks, delivery schedules and milestones.
* Coordinate with developers, designers, content writers and other relevant teams.
* Manage website content updates, publishing workflows and quality assurance.
* Monitor website functionality, performance, availability and user experience.
* Coordinate testing, bug resolution, security updates and backups with the technical team.
* Establish content approval, access control and publishing procedures.
* Maintain documentation, issue trackers and delivery reports.
* Ensure that the platform meets agreed functional and reporting requirements.
* Coordinate with project leadership on changes, dependencies and technical risks.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Graduate in Computer Science, IT, Engineering or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* 6–12 years of experience in website development, digital platform management or web project delivery.
* Experience managing developers and coordinating technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Working knowledge of CMS platforms, website hosting, analytics, testing and website maintenance.
* Strong project planning, troubleshooting and communication skills.
* Experience delivering portals or websites under tight project deadlines preferred.

**Ideal Candidate**

A hands-on digital project manager who can coordinate technical delivery, content publishing and platform reliability within a short project timeline.

**Application Instructions:** Please share your CV and details of websites or portals delivered or managed.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹75,000.00 per month

title: Tech Writer
description:
As a Tech Writer here at Honeywell, you will have the opportunity to develop and implement documentation standards, processes, and best practices. Your expertise in technical writing principles, style guides, and industry standards will ensure consistency and adherence to quality guidelines. You will also review and edit technical documents for clarity, consistency, and adherence to style guidelines.

In this role, you will impact documentation quality, team performance, cross-functional collaboration, process efficiency, compliance, and continuous improvement.

  

YOU MUST HAVE

* Minimum of 0 years of proven experience in technical writing, preferably in a principal or senior role
* Strong knowledge of technical writing principles, style guides, and documentation standards
* Proficiency in using authoring tools such as MadCap Flare, Adobe FrameMaker, or similar
* Excellent writing, editing, and proofreading skills
* Ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to a non-technical audience
* Experience in leading and mentoring technical writing teams

WE VALUE

* Bachelor's degree in Technical Communication, English, or a related field
* Desired experience
* Desired trait

  

Key Responsibilities

* Lead the development of high-quality technical documentation for complex products and systems
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather information and ensure accuracy of technical content
* Research, analyze, and interpret technical information to create clear and concise documentation
* Develop and implement documentation standards, processes, and best practices
* Review and edit technical documents for clarity, consistency, and adherence to style guidelines
* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards
* Provide guidance and mentorship to junior technical writers
* Stay updated with industry trends and advancements in technical writing tools and methodologies

  
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Credit Documentation Specialist - Analyst
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Are you ready to make a difference in client delivery and lending solutions? Join a dynamic team where your expertise shapes client experiences and drives operational excellence. You'll collaborate with talented colleagues, develop your skills, and play a key role in supporting complex transactions. Experience career growth, skill development, and the opportunity to innovate in a supportive environment. Be part of a culture that values your ideas and empowers you to succeed.

As a Credit Documentation Specialist - Analyst within the Global Banking Client and Deal Support Credit Product Delivery team, you will facilitate and manage the deal lifecycle from mandate through execution. You will serve as the first point of contact for bankers and trade sales, providing transaction support for local, mid-corporates, multinational corporations and its subsidiary clients. You will ensure seamless document execution and deal closing, while maintaining a strong risk and control framework. You will work closely with local, regional and global teams to deliver consistent, client-focused support and operational excellence.

Our team is dedicated to delivering best-in-class client experiences and supporting a wide range of lending and trade finance solutions. You will partner with credit, legal, compliance, and operations teams to ensure seamless execution and risk management. We foster a collaborative environment focused on innovation, continuous improvement, and professional growth.

**Job responsibilities**

* Facilitate and manage the deal lifecycle from mandate through execution
* Serve as the primary contact for bankers and trade sales, providing transaction support
* Oversee document execution and deal closing processes for complex transactions including handling of complex security structure.
* Collaborate with credit, legal, compliance, and operations teams to deliver seamless support
* Maintain a strong risk and control framework throughout the deal process
* Support transactions for Local, Mid-Corporates, MNC's and it's subsidiary.
* Ensure timely and accurate completion of documentation and execution tasks
* Identify and escalate issues to appropriate teams as needed
* Drive process improvements and participate in change initiatives
* Deliver superior client experiences through proactive communication and support
* Manage multiple priorities and timelines effectively

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Bachelor's degree
* At least 3 years of experience in Credit Administration, Transaction Management, or Credit Execution related roles within the Banking industry
* Strong knowledge of credit facility documentation and security structure across lending products.
* Proactive self-starter with ability to manage multiple tasks and timelines
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
* Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to drive change
* Demonstrated control mindset with focus on continual improvement
* Highly organized, motivated, and able to escalate issues appropriately

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Ability to create a vision and actionable roadmap for ongoing innovation
* Client-facing experience
* Data analysis skills and familiarity with Tableau or other data visualization tools

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. title: Export Documentation Executive
description:
Job Title: Export Documentation Executive

Job Summary: Responsible for preparing, verifying, and managing export documents to ensure timely and compliant international shipments in accordance with customs regulations and company procedures.

Key Responsibilities

* Prepare export documents, including commercial invoices, packing lists, shipping bills, and bills of lading.
* Coordinate with freight forwarders, customs brokers, shipping lines, and transporters.
* Prepare and verify certificates of origin and other applicable export certificates.
* Coordinate with banks for Letter of Credit (LC) documentation and export payment documents.
* Ensure compliance with DGFT, customs, and other applicable export regulations.
* Track export shipments and maintain records of dispatches and documentation.
* Coordinate with production, sales, logistics, and warehouse teams.
* Handle post-shipment documentation and resolve documentation discrepancies.

* Knowledge of export-import (EXIM) procedures and documentation.
* Understanding of Incoterms, shipping terms, and customs clearance.
* Good communication, coordination, and organizational skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and documentation systems.
